note: The CoM shift is an ABSOLUTE distance in the lab frame (no alignment is performed); the rigid-fragment RMSD in the companion JSON IS alignment-based (GetBestRMS with symmetry-aware MCS overlay). For molecules that share no common substructure with the reference (e.g. benzene vs aspirin), rigid_fragment_rmsd returns None — this is the canonical 'no overlay possible' semantics.
